AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION

07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Location: Rosedale Tract: 54057-3 and 54057-12

Design Review application requesting approval of the architectural design, layout and construction of sixty-six (66) single-family homes distributed between two approved tracts within the Rosedale Planned Community. Request to construct a duplex by adding a new dwelling unit attached to the rear of an existing single-family home and construction of a detached four-car garage located at the rear of the property. A Variance is requested to allow reduced side yard setbacks of 1 and 1.5 feet instead of the required 3 foot side yard setbacks for the proposed detached garage.
